home: Arms & Iron smithy, Nebruz — the only stone building in the village
appearance: Short human woman; corded arm muscles, close-cropped hair. Iron ring on right hand (enchanted against divination). Communicates in grunts and monosyllables.
and_yet: MU9 — a former imperial wizard who forged enchanted blades for nobility. Presents entirely as a simple smith. Dorota knows; Effemi does not know Dorota knows.
wants: Anonymity; her past buried; to keep smithing in peace
does_not_want: Anyone from her former life finding her; any reason to reveal her magical abilities
tragedies: A courtly coup stripped her of her imperial position and set magical and political rivals on her trail
pc_leverage: Ordinary circumstances will not move her; an overwhelming threat to Nebruz might force her hand; her smithwork is excellent despite low-grade bog iron
